name: Saros: Zenith
summary:
Saros: Zenith adds Overlord Rush, a brand-new mode where players take on the powerful Overlord enemies from the main game back-to-back, chase a high score, and compete with players worldwide on integrated leaderboards.

This update also brings "Eclipse Layers", a new game+ mode which allows seasoned enforcers to put their skills to the ultimate test. After clearing Saros, players can return to the beginning and take on a more challenging version of the game. You can rise to meet these trials with even more progression options and new Carcosan Modifiers to customize your experience. Players can also discover new secrets and trophies.

New accessibility features, including High-Contrast visuals, gyro aiming with the DualSense wireless controller, and the toggleable "Slow Game Speed" option, have been added.
